steps.en: Start a standalone server in Docker
steps.zh: 用 Docker 起一个单机版服务

steps.en: Runs Milvus with embedded etcd and local storage, serving on port 19530
steps.zh: 带内置 etcd 和本地存储跑起来，在 19530 端口提供服务

steps.en: Connect with the Python SDK and create a collection sized to your embeddings
steps.zh: 用 Python SDK 连上，按向量维度建一个集合

steps.en: Insert your vectors together with their metadata fields
steps.zh: 把向量连同元数据字段一起写进去

steps.en: Logs the writes, packs them into segments and builds an ANN index over them
steps.zh: 先记日志，再把数据打包成分段并建好近邻索引

steps.en: Search with a batch of query vectors and a top-k limit
steps.zh: 拿一批查询向量去搜，指定取前 k 条

steps.en: Searches the loaded segments, applies filters and merges one top-k answer
steps.zh: 在已加载的分段里检索、套用过滤条件，合并出一份 top-k

value.en: Filtered nearest-neighbor search over a collection that can grow from one container to a sharded cluster without changing client code
value.zh: 带过滤的近邻检索，集合从一个容器长到分片集群，客户端代码不用改
